source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    from collections import Counter
    background = Counter(v for row in out for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Extend every diagonal pair of the same non-background color through empty background cells.
    for r in range(h - 1):
        for c in range(w):
            for dc in (-1, 1):
                rr, cc = r + 1, c + dc
                if not (0 <= cc < w):
                    continue
                color = grid[r][c]
                if color == background or color != grid[rr][cc]:
                    continue
                for sr, sc in ((-1, -dc), (1, dc)):
                    y, x = (r, c) if sr < 0 else (rr, cc)
                    while 0 <= y + sr < h and 0 <= x + sc < w and out[y + sr][x + sc] == background:
                        y += sr
                        x += sc
                        out[y][x] = color
    return out
'''
